description_en: Queries the backup sets of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查看RDS实例的备份集列表
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:
Success: The backup is complete.
Failed: The backup failed
parameters.help_zh:
备份集状态。取值：
Success：已完成备份
Failed：备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:
Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC). Narrow down the time range when you use this operation to query backup sets. A large time range may cause a timeout
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 建议您在使用本接口查询备份集列表信息时，将查询开始和结束的时间段缩小一些，如果时间段较长可能出现超时问题
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
FullBackup: full backup
IncrementalBackup: incremental backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：
FullBackup：全量备份
IncrementalBackup：增量备份
parameters.name: backup_type

items.description_en: The details of the backup set

BackupDownloadLinkByDB.description_en:
The list of download links for individual database backups.

This parameter is not returned for cloud disk instances
BackupDownloadLinkByDB.description_zh:
单库备份下载链接列表。

云盘实例不返回该参数

items.description_en: The details of the download link for an individual database backup
items.description_zh: 单库备份下载链接详情

BackupDownloadURL.description_en:
The public download URL. An empty string is returned if the backup set is not available for download.

For example, an empty string is returned for an SQL Server instance that uses snapshot backup.

This parameter is not returned for cloud disk instances
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh:
公网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则返回空值。

例如：备份方式为快照备份的SQL Server实例会返回空值。

云盘实例不返回该参数

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupInitiator.description_en:
The initiator of the backup task. Valid values:
System: The backup is automatically initiated by the system.
User: The backup is manually initiated by the user
BackupInitiator.description_zh:
备份任务的发起者。返回值：
System：系统自动发起。
User：用户手动发起

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en:
The internal download URL. An empty string is returned if the backup set is not available for download.

For example, an empty string is returned for an SQL Server instance that uses snapshot backup.

This parameter is not returned for cloud disk instances
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh:
内网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则返回空值。

例如：备份方式为快照备份的SQL Server实例会返回空值。

云盘实例不返回该参数

BackupMethod.description_en:
The backup method. Valid values:
Logical: logical backup
Physical: physical backup
Snapshot: snapshot backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方式，返回值：
Logical：逻辑备份
Physical：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:
Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，返回值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en: The status of the backup set

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
FullBackup: full backup
IncrementalBackup: incremental backup
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值：
FullBackup：全量备份
IncrementalBackup：增量备份

Checksum.description_en: The checksum. The CRC64 algorithm is used

ConsistentTime.description_en:
The consistent point in time of the backup set. The value is a UNIX timestamp.
This parameter is returned only for MySQL 5.6. The value 0 is returned for other versions
ConsistentTime.description_zh:
备份集的一致性时间点。返回值为时间戳。
仅MySQL 5.6返回本参数，其他版本返回0

CopyOnlyBackup.description_en:
The backup mode of the SQL Server instance. The value specifies whether the backup is a regular backup (which supports full and incremental restoration) or a copy-only backup (which supports only full restoration). Valid values:
0: regular backup mode
1: copy-only mode
CopyOnlyBackup.description_zh:
SQL Server实例备份模式，分为常规备份模式（支持全量和增量恢复）和仅复制模式（仅支持全量恢复），返回值：
0：常规备份模式
1：仅复制模式

Encryption.description_en: The encryption information of the backup set

Engine.description_en:
The database engine. Valid values:
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB
Engine.description_zh:
数据库类型。返回值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB

ExpectExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the backup set. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC). This value is returned only after you configure the backup set retention period for individual database backups of SQL Server instances
ExpectExpireTime.description_zh: 备份集过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC 时间）。 仅SQL Server单库备份设置备份集保留天数后返回该值

HostInstanceID.description_en: The ID of the instance that generated the backup set. This parameter is used to indicate whether the backup set was generated on the primary instance or the secondary instance
HostInstanceID.description_zh: 产生备份集的实例编号，用于区分该备份集产生于主实例或备实例

IsAvail.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set is available. Valid values:
0: unavailable
1: available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，返回值：
0：不可用
1：可用

MetaStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set for database and table restoration. Valid values:
OK: The backup set is normal.
LARGE: The number of tables is too large. The backup set cannot be used for database and table restoration.
EMPTY: The backup set is from a failed backup.

An empty string indicates that the database and table restoration feature is not enabled for the backup set
MetaStatus.description_zh:
库表恢复的备份集状态，返回值：
OK：正常。
LARGE：表数量过多，不能用于库表恢复。
EMPTY：备份失败的备份集。

空串表示未开通库表恢复的备份集

StorageClass.description_en:
The storage medium of the backup set. Valid values:
0: regular storage
1: archive storage
StorageClass.description_zh:
备份集的存储介质，返回值：
0：常规存储
1：归档存储

StoreStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the data backup can be deleted. Valid values:
Enabled: The backup can be deleted.
Disabled: The backup cannot be deleted
StoreStatus.description_zh:
该数据备份是否可删除，返回值：
Enabled：可删除
Disabled：不可删除

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of backup sets on the current page

TotalEcsSnapshotSize.description_en: The size of the snapshot chain of the instance. Unit: bytes
TotalEcsSnapshotSize.description_zh: 实例的快照链大小，单位：字节（Byte）
